inputs.model: inserts write bytes per byte = r_large + c / insert_rows: a fixed per-part overhead (marks, checksums, columns, count, serialization and statistics files, page rounding) that does not grow with rows
inputs.interpolation: 1.1653 at 10 000 rows; range = c range / 10000 +- the scalar rule (2 x spread + 10 % + 0.005)

baseline.write_bps.r1.reason: a counter delta is never negative

inserts.max_request_bucket.write.reason: write and read buffers are 1 MiB

inserts.max_request_bucket.read.reason: write and read buffers are 1 MiB

merges.max_request_bucket.write.reason: write and read buffers are 1 MiB

merges.max_request_bucket.read.reason: write and read buffers are 1 MiB

reads.max_request_bucket.write.reason: write and read buffers are 1 MiB

reads.max_request_bucket.read.reason: write and read buffers are 1 MiB

source_refs.claim: part files are written through a buffer of DBMS_DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE
DBMS_DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE is 1 MiB: a buffer flush writes at most that much
it takes precedence over max_read_buffer_size for the local filesystem
local_filesystem_read_method is pread_threadpool: reads are pread syscalls
min_bytes_to_use_direct_io is 0: reads go through the page cache
